Full-depth fan-out: family "Connectivity and placement — fabric, control service, interop, cells". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Moves: the fabric holds (the connectivity programme's standing), the control-service boundary holds (agent-hosting separation kept), Factory interop gathers (the neighbouring product received), multi-workcell placement turns (placement across cells — 3D: z is placement across the room of rooms), remote file sharing gathers (the tailnet reaching the Mac Finder).

3D: the member's depth is situated placement in a room — z is the Workcell's own here-ness: the workstation face nearest, the placed world deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers: guard=placed bounds hold, gather=material gathered, vortex=lifecycle turns, rupture=the demand cuts in, settle=the room at rest. Automation: one LFO per member — the placed world breathes. Sequences walk each record's own heading words — placement is the Workcell's native grammar.
